ablauf.h2: From first contact to a confirmed training camp
ablauf.1.title: Request
ablauf.1.desc: You send us the key details on your team, timeframe and desired services via the form.
ablauf.2.title: Offer
ablauf.2.desc: We put together a tailored offer — accommodation, pitches, test matches, transfer.
ablauf.3.title: Confirmation
ablauf.3.desc: Once you approve, we take care of the full organisation on site.
ablauf.promise: Response within 24 hours. Every request is personally reviewed and answered by our team.

step4.title: Desired services
step5.title: Almost done
step5.intro: One more short message, then you can submit.
summary.title: Your details
step5.gdpr: I have read the privacy policy. Your details are emailed to us to answer your request and are not used for other purposes.
success.title: Request sent
success.text: Thank you! Your request has reached us. We usually reply within 24 hours.
faq.1.q: How fast will we get an offer?
faq.1.a: Usually within 24 hours of your request. For more complex requests we may first follow up with a quick question.
faq.2.q: What team sizes are training camps suitable for?
faq.2.a: From small youth squads to full professional squads with staff — the infrastructure is matched to your group size.
faq.3.q: Can you also organise test matches?
faq.3.a: Yes, we arrange suitable local opponents matched to your level and schedule.
faq.4.q: What happens to the data from the form?
faq.4.a: Your details are used solely to process the request and stored in compliance with GDPR. See the privacy policy for details.
